output_file.description: Filename to write the output image to. Use '-' for stdout.

input_data.description: The plain text data to encode into the QR code.

level.description: Error correction level: L, M, Q, or H.

dot_size.description: Size of each dot (module) in pixels.

margin.description: Width of the quiet zone (margin) in modules.

output_type.description: Output format: PNG, PNG32, EPS, SVG, XPM, ANSI, ASCII, UTF8, etc.

structured_append.description: Enable structured append mode for split QR codes.

micro_qr.description: Encode using Micro QR Code format.

svg_path.description: Use single path to draw modules for SVG.

foreground_color.description: Foreground color in Hex RGB or RGBA.

background_color.description: Background color in Hex RGB or RGBA.

strict_version.description: Disable automatic version adjustment; exit if data too large.
